issues.quote: How I used to wait for them, at times!
Let cleanness and peace come into the house.
They wove their existence together with mine into a fantastic net

strengths.quote: I am sick of being an inn where those creatures forever crowd and shove, shout, bustle and litter.
Would they close behind me, and the iron hand clack its bones in vain?
strengths.why: eerie, memorable extension of the metaphor

strengths.quote: petty, useless words, like chips and straw on the spring floods…
…a lady I know suffered fifteen years with her heart… clickety-clack-clack… our division was stationed back then…
strengths.why: overheard fragments and train rhythm drown the silence

strengths.quote: the roaring torrents of human life that came rushing at me like wild horses from every street of the city
strengths.why: makes the noise feel physical and threatening
